P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait or dominant human anchor on this page; the layout relies entirely on typography and abstract graphics.

P05.rationale: The client name 'Hanisch & Klein' is clearly framed within a distinct dark panel with meaningful size and visual weight.

P07.rationale: A social-proof apparatus exists in the form of a testimonial quote at the bottom right, though it lacks a formal grid or rating cards.

P10.rationale: The page features an oversized decorative typographic element: a giant '05' numeral that acts as a major visual anchor.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualizations are present in the form of specific percentage metrics (e.g., '100% automatisiert') and comparative statements rather than empty frames.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text blocks, panels, and graphics without sparse gaps.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is present through the use of a dark blue panel and subtle paper grain effects on the off-white background.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page to require treatment or text readability checks.

P16.rationale: There are no device or product mockups shown; the visual elements consist of typography and abstract geometric shapes.

N07.rationale: The imagery is not generic stock but specific to a real business context (B2B consulting), though it lacks photographic realism.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content blocks and text columns.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos without scrim because there are no full-bleed photographs present to create this conflict.
